fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder (around 0x7100689ec4) stores vptr 0x7104f743e8 and the boma, then the object goes to boma+0x150.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Stored with the vptr; is_visible reads LinkModule through [+0x8]+0xD0, the apply step reads ModelModule ([+0x8]+0x78) and the module at [+0x8]+0x140.

fields.name: whole
fields.evidence: get_whole slot (+0xC8, f_71004e2560) loads the byte; set_whole (export calls +0xC0 = f_71004e2550) stores arg&1. Constructor and reset (+0x38, f_71004e1b10) set 1.

fields.name: model_visible
fields.evidence: set_model_visible (export calls +0x118 = f_71004e2730) stores arg&1; unexported getter +0x120 loads it; the apply step (+0xA8, f_71004e2340) passes (is_visible && model_visible) to ModelModule virtual +0x1C0 and to the boma+0x140 module's virtual +0x408. Init 1.

fields.name: visible_sub_flag
fields.evidence: Unexported setter +0x128 (f_71004e2750); is_visible requires it with whole. Init/reset 1.

fields.name: visibility_desc
fields.evidence: init (+0x28, f_71004e15e0) stores its arg2. Points to a descriptor: [+0x0,+0x8] vector of 0x28-byte group records whose +0x20 is the group's initial default part hash (reset_status_default f_71004e1d90 and +0xE8 read it); [+0x18,+0x20] vector of 16-byte mesh records (group hash at +0x8). Init calls the per-group reset (+0x48) for every group record.

fields.name: group_index_maps
fields.evidence: Owned object built by vtable +0x130 (f_71004e2760) and freed by finalize (+0x30): a sorted tree at +0x0 (root at +0x8) maps a group hash40 (40-bit) to an index (node key +0x20, index +0x28); a second tree at +0x18 (root +0x20) maps a mesh hash to a mesh record. Every group method (set, set_status_default, set_default, set_mesh_visibility...) looks the hash up here first and does nothing when null or not found.

fields.name: group_states
fields.evidence: Array of 0x18-byte group states indexed by the map's index: +0x0 status-default part hash40, +0x8 current part hash40, +0x10 u8 state (0 clean, 1 changed, 2 material-anim priority), +0x11 i8 mesh visibility (MESH_VISIBILITY_*: 0 false, 1 true, 2 none). set (+0x50, f_71004e1b90) writes +0x8 and broadcasts event 0x2C (group, old, new); set_status_default (+0x60) writes +0x0 then calls set_default; set_default (+0xD8, f_71004e2570) = set(group, +0x0); set_mesh_visibility (+0x90, f_71004e1fc0) writes +0x11; the per-group reset (+0x48, f_71004e1b50) sets +0x0 = hash40 'invalid' (0x07fb997a80), +0x8 = 0x167280e877, state 0, visibility 1.

fields.name: part_resolver_callback
fields.evidence: init stores a C++ member-function pointer {0x71004e4070 or 0x71004e4100, adj 0} depending on virtual +0xF8 (has visibility data); set_material_anim_priority (+0xA0, f_71004e20e0) calls it to get a part hash.

fields.name: visibility_mode
fields.evidence: set_visibility_mode (+0x110, f_71004e2720) stores it; unexported getter +0x108 loads it; constructor/reset 1 = VISIBILITY_MODE_GUARANTEE (lua_const). In mode 1 set_material_anim_priority walks the per-group mesh lists at +0x68.

fields.name: mesh_vector
fields.evidence: begin/end/cap at +0x50/+0x58/+0x60; rebuilt by +0x130 and emptied (end = begin) by finalize.

fields.name: group_mesh_lists
fields.evidence: begin/end/cap at +0x68/+0x70/+0x78 of 0x18-byte elements, each itself a vector of vectors of 32-bit mesh indices, one per group index; set_material_anim_priority reads it; finalize frees the inner vectors.

fields.name: groups_changed
fields.evidence: Set to 1 by set / set_status_default when a part changes; cleared by set_default_all (+0x88) and reset_status_default_all (+0x80). Constructor 1.

fields.name: flag_81
fields.evidence: Unexported +0xF0 (f_71004e2690) stores arg&1; constructor 0 (from the 16-bit store of 1 at +0x80).

fields.name: mesh_dirty
fields.evidence: Set when a group state becomes 1 (set, set_mesh_visibility, set_material_anim_priority); the apply step (+0xA8) then pushes mesh visibility (f_71004e3960) and clears it. Init 0.

pointers.to: visibility descriptor (group records 0x28 bytes, mesh records 0x10 bytes)
owned pair of hash->index trees (groups at +0x0, meshes at +0x18)
group state array, 0x18 bytes per group

notes: Fighter-side class is 0x7104f743e8 (136 bytes); 0x7104f745d0 (24 bytes) is a stub class whose slots are empty functions (f_71003ba5xx-6xx). Getters: get_whole is a plain load; is_visible (+0xD0, f_71004e41c0) = whole && +0x12 && LinkModule virtual +0x118 (parent visibility); is_visible_mesh for the fighter class (+0x100, f_71004e2700) always returns false. *_int64 exports go to separate slots that forward to the hash versions. Unexported +0xE8 tells whether a group's status default differs from its initial default; +0xF8 tells whether the descriptor has visibility data (not a single 'invalid' entry). The second reset hash 0x167280e877 has no label in ParamLabels. Offsets +0x83..+0x87 are padding.
